data.title: Women face hygiene woes in Nepal flood relief camp
data.description: NUWAKOT, Nepal - Scores of women queued at a school sheltering Nepal flood victims, jostling to lreceive personal-care supplies, as concerns over sanitation and menstrual hygiene mount days after the catastrophic disaster.

data.title: Ukraine’s defences, ‘hybrid’ threat from Moscow headline EU talks
data.description: WICKLOW, Ireland - EU defence ministers grappled on Tuesday with bolstering Ukraine’s air defences, as worries grow over Russia’s campaign to destabilise Kyiv’s European backers.

data.title: Tibet activists accuse China of downplaying floods
data.description: DHARAMSALA, India - Exiled Tibetans and advocacy groups have accused China of heavily underreporting the death toll from devastating flooding in border regions with Nepal, claims Beijing rejected as “malicious smearing and sensationalism”.

data.title: Brothers linked to Australia-bound ‘ice’ shipments
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - Two Thai brothers were arrested on Tuesday for alleged involvement in a Rayong-based drug smuggling network that used tourist boats to ferry their illegal Australia-bound cargo.

data.title: National disaster insurance scheme approved
data.description: The cabinet on Tuesday approved in principle the establishment of a National Disaster Insurance System to provide coverage for floods, storms and earthquakes, expected to cover about 30 million households.

data.title: Cabinet approves new national security chief
data.description: Cabinet approved the appointment of army chief of staff Gen Chaiyapruek Duangpraphat as new secretary-general of the National Security Council (NSC) during its mobile meeting in Songkhla on Tuesday.

data.title: Dissevered body scattered along train tracks in Hat Yai
data.description: SONGKHLA - The dissevered body of a 62-year-old Myanmar man was found scattered along the railway track under the Lopburi Ramesuan twin bridges in Hat Yai, Songkhla, on Monday evening.

data.title: Chud Thai heads for UNESCO consideration this year
data.description: Eleven Thai national-dress styles face UNESCO review later this year as Thailand promotes traditional textiles through contemporary fashion.

data.title: Audemars Piguet unveils its new boutique concept in bangkok
data.description: Swiss HauteHorlogeriemanufacturerAudemars Piguetiscontinuing the international rollout of itsglobal boutique conceptinthe heart ofBangkok,attheCentral Embassymall.An immersive environment with watches at the centre, the new space spans 264 square metres. Drawing inspiration from the landscapes surrounding Audemars Piguet’s home in LeBrassus, the contemporary interior design invites visitors to step into the Manufacture’s heritage and forward-looking approach to fine watchmaking. Unveiled on 15 June, the boutique will be complemented by an interactive pop-up installation from 11-25 August that offers the public an opportunity to discover the Royal Oak Offshore and its distinctive design codes.

data.title: The Science of Brain Recovery: Neurobiology, Clinical Evidence, and Integrated Treatment for Addiction and Mental Health
data.description: For decades, substance dependence and chronic mood disorders were widely misunderstood as personal shortcomings or failures of willpower. Modern neuroscience and clinical medicine have fundamentally shifted this paradigm: substance use disorders (SUD) and psychiatric conditions are complex neurobiological disorders involving structural and chemical dysregulations within the central nervous system.

data.title: 30-day visa-free stays to take effect on Sept 15
data.description: The new 30-day limit for visa-free stays in Thailand has been formally announced and will take effect on Sept 15 for visitors from 60 countries.

data.title: Drunken Indian tourist decked in Pattaya car park
data.description: PATTAYA - A drunken, unruly Indian tourist was left unconscious, vomiting on the ground during an altercation in a carpark near a popular seafood restaurant in the early hours of the morning.

data.title: Sihasak favours extending border fence with Malaysia
data.description: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow wants to further extend the fence long the border with Malaysia to help curb smuggling of untaxed goods and drugs.

data.title: Rain boots favoured by British royals are Bangkok-bound
data.description: Iconic Wellington boots are arriving in Thailand just in time for the rainy season, with the British heritage footwear brand Hunter opening its first store in the country at Iconsiam.

data.title: Nonthaburi school reopens after deadly shootings
data.description: The Nonthaburi school where ​a student went on a deadly shooting rampage three weeks ago reopened on Tuesday ​amid heightened security, with police deployed and ‌checks performed on bags.

data.title: Gastech 2026 Brings Global Energy Leaders to Bangkok as Asia Drives the Next Wave of Demand
data.description: The world’s largest exhibition and conference for natural gas, LNG, low-carbon solutions, hydrogen, shipping, AI for energy and electrification comes to Bangkokas Asia’s economic transformation creates new opportunities across the energy sector

data.title: Japan to relax overtime regulation under workaholic PM
data.description: TOKYO — Japan will ease overtime regulation starting Tuesday in a move meant to help spur economic growth but criticised as a relapse into the country's ingrained workaholic culture.

data.title: Afghanistan war victims left 'without justice', UN says
data.description: KABUL - Most civilian victims of Afghanistan's 2001-2021 war have been left "without justice, reparation or even acknowledgement" of their suffering, the United Nations (UN) said Tuesday, with one man in Kabul telling Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) "the world has forgotten us".

data.title: Iran president offers US olive branch before Putin meeting
data.description: BISHKEK (KYRGYZSTAN) - Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian on Tuesday vowed to match any US move to return to a June deal aimed at ending their war, as he prepares to meet Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin at a regional summit.

data.title: China-Nepal flood toll tops 1,000 as tunnel rescue offers last hope
data.description: NUWAKOT — The death toll from devastating Himalayan glacial floods crossed the grim 1,000 mark on Tuesday, as Chinese and Nepali teams searched for survivors including dozens feared trapped in hydropower tunnels.

data.title: Autumn flavours come to life at The Authors’ Lounge Bangkok
data.description: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok celebrates autumn at The Authors’ Lounge with seasonal afternoon tea, fresh scones and desserts from September 1 to November 30.

data.title: Cannabis, watersports ban for US sailors visiting Pattaya
data.description: Cannabis and most watersports are on the "banned" list for the thousands of US navy personnel from the carrier group visiting Chon Buri and Pattaya this week.

data.title: Nepal's wall of missing offers last hope after Himalayan flood
data.description: KATHMANDU — In Nepal's capital, desperate people searching for family members missing after Wednesday's devastating floods post photographs on a wall, clinging to a final, fading hope of finding them.

data.title: Defence tech hub Munich booms as Europe rearms
data.description: MUNICH — Munich is booming as a hub for young defence tech firms making everything from AI-powered drones to cutting-edge military software as Europe rearms to face an increasingly dangerous world.

data.title: Buri Ram prison suspends visits after positive Covid tests
data.description: BURI RAM - Nang Rong Prison has suspended family visits to three of its zones for one month after around 50 inmates tested positive for Covid-19 and several others were found to have scabies.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil Anane’s kickboxing return against Yuki Yoza set for Samurai 4
data.description: Nabil Anane will make the kickboxing return he floated after consecutive Muay Thai defeats when he faces Yuki Yoza at ONE Samurai 4 in Tokyo on October 17.

data.title: Many data centres in Bangkok built without permission, says digital minister
data.description: Many data centres were operating without permission in Bangkok, with authorities investigating fuel stockpiling and possible foreign investment in the facilities, Digital Economy and Society (DES) Minister Chaichanok Chidchob said on Tuesday.

data.title: Fire guts 15 homes in Makkasan community, one dead
data.description: A fire tore through a residential community in Soi Sukhumvit 3, Makkasan sub-district, Ratchathewi district, in the early hours of Tuesday, killing one person and damaging about 15 houses.

data.title: Vacheron Constantin’s newest collection is a tribute to the animal kingdom
data.description: Six extraordinary timepieces transform rare decorative crafts into tiny scenes of the natural world, pushing centuries-old artisanal techniques to microscopic proportions.

data.title: Nigeria rethinks criminalisation of suicide
data.description: LAGOS - In Nigeria, surviving a suicide attempt can mean facing not only the trauma of the ordeal but also the threat of prosecution.

data.title: 'Massive' Russian missile, drone attack on Kyiv kills 8
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - A "massive" Russian attack killed at least eight people in Kyiv overnight, including seven at a railways depot, officials said Tuesday, as Moscow pressed its air campaign on the Ukrainian capital and surrounding areas.

data.title: US teen charged with aiding mosque shooters share livestream, manifesto
data.description: NORTH CAROLINA — A jury charged a teen in the US state of North Carolina on Monday with allegedly aiding two other teenagers livestream their shooting rampage of a mosque on the other side of the country in May.

data.title: “Lisa Effect” Turns Thailand’s Travel Dreams into Real Search Demand
data.description: Traveloka data suggests TAT’s Lisa-led “Feel All the Feelings” campaign is gaining momentum, with searches and bookings rising for Thai destinations from Udon Thani to Rayong.

data.title: Pattaya Turns 365 Days of Events into a World-Class City Strategy
data.description: Pattaya is using year-round events across sport, music, culture, pride, wellness and business travel to raise its profile as a world-class event city and strengthen Thailand’s tourism economy.

data.title: Pinehurst Reframes Golf as "Science-Backed Wellness" for Modern Lifestyles
data.description: Amid growing interest in health and wellness—particularly cardiovascular health and stroke prevention—one question increasingly facing people today may not simply be, “What exercise should I do?” but rather, “How can I choose an activity that I can enjoy consistently and that fits naturally into my lifestyle?”

data.title: Man dies in fall from escalator at Bangkok shopping centre
data.description: A man believed to be in his 30s died in a fall from a moving escalator at a shopping centre near Asok intersection in Bangkok on Monday night.

data.title: Popular Thi Lo Su waterfall reopens in Tak
data.description: TAK - The magnificent Thi Lo Su waterfall in Umphang district reopened to the public on Tuesday after being closed for two months to allow natural rehabilitation - but only for four-wheel-drive vehicles.

data.title: US Army Secretary Driscoll submits resignation: White House
data.description: WASHINGTON — US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has submitted his resignation, the White House confirmed Monday, following reports of tensions with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
